name: aside-antigravity-bridge
description: Local OpenAI-compatible bridge from Aside to Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist

scripts.login: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.mjs login
scripts.serve: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.mjs serve
scripts.status: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.mjs status
scripts.key: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.mjs key
scripts.models: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.mjs models
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
